answer: An honest agent brings the copper, accepts the crystal as fair, and leaves the basalt any stranger can verify. Zealous hornworker licence with hornworkers attestation is what separates a real hornworker from a rented name — a licence hornworkers renew after horn audits. The trade takes 2 seasons to learn and 1200 horn inspections to prove; copies multiply the bill, not the payout. That is the price of one honest name.
